newsitem.title: UK: Oftel to force BT to postpone cuts - paper.
newsitem.headline: Oftel to force BT to postpone cuts - paper.

text.p: Telecom regulator Oftel will this week force British Telecommunications Plc (BT) to postpone plans to cut high-speed digital communications services because rivals say they are anti-competitive, the Independent newspaper reported in its Monday edition.
The price cuts on ISDN lines were announced on August 23, and the newspaper quoted BT as saying it was confused by Oftel's planned action.
The company said in a statement that it was "surprised and preplexed" by thew watchdog's decision, announced in a letter received by BT late on Friday afternoon.
"The cuts will have to go ahead from midnight on Sunday night because we physically can't stop them," a spokeswoman was quoted by the newspaper as saying.
But BT confirmed that competitors such as Mercury Communications had complained about the proposed reductions.
